notes.title: Adding functions such as Material Reset, Look At, and Physics Simplification Opt
notes.content:
[h1]Material Reset[/h1] 
After unchecking the "Enable Material Settings" option in the material panel, a reset button will appear. Clicking it will reset the material settings.
 [h1]Look At Camera[/h1] 
By checking the "Look At" option in the camera panel, the model will continuously face the camera. [h1]Physics Simplification Option[/h1] 
When loading, overly complex models will undergo automatic physics simplification, which may affect physical performance. This operation can be undone for the model on the "Model" - "Modify" page.

notes.title: Add VR joint touch interaction
notes.content:
[h1][b]Add VR joint touch interaction[/b][/h1]
The VR mode adds movable joints to the MMD model, allowing you to use handles to pose various poses or do other interesting things for your favorite characters in the virtual world.

After importing the model, enter VR mode, press the function key on the left handle to call up the menu, and then press the "palm" shaped switch to activate this function.
After approaching the joints such as hands, feet, and waist, operation prompts will appear. Press the grip button on the handle to operate.
(This feature currently only supports PMX format models)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43757864/0b09c43710ef7f8f9b8bf75dfe52b31fdc439fff.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=Fkv5-SG311M;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Added support for VPD pose files[/b][/h1]
Added a "Pose" tag in the "Motion" panel to import *.VPD poses


[h1][b]Add green screen background[/b][/h1]
"Lighting" - "Mode 2" - "Sky" - Added "Green" option, making it convenient to combine with other software to achieve mixed reality MMD animation playback

[h1][b]Add a dynamic scene[/b][/h1]
It can be found under "Model" - "Scene"

notes.title: Added support for steam workshop, Add functions such as material modification.
notes.content:
[h1][b]Added support for steam workshop[/b][/h1]
The steam workshop for character models, motions, camera, and scenes has been opened. You can click on the "Steam Workshop" tab on the corresponding UI to enter


[h1][b]Add a material modifier[/b][/h1]
After selecting the model, click the "Material" button in the "Model list" or "scene"  to enter

[h1][b]Add reflection light rendering[/b][/h1]
Enhanced light and shadow effects, you can drag the "Lighting" - "Reflected" slider to set its intensity, and you can also control the degree to which each material is affected by reflected light in the Material modifier.

[img]https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/em/act2.jpg[/img]

[h1][Add lighting color settings[/b][/h1]
Click on the color block next to "Lighting" - "Color" to enter
[h1][b]Add depth of field effect[/b][/h1]
Set in 'Settings'
[h1][b]Add the function of outputting video files[/b][/h1]
Select the "Record Screen" button (the red circle button on the left of the play bar) before playing the animation, and then click "Play". MP4 files will be generated after playing or actively clicking the end. You can go to the folder where the recording is saved in "Settings" - "Recording Directory"
[img]https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/em/act1_en.jpg[/img]
